pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions consist of large, irregular polygonal shapes with high-angularity edges and sharp pixel gradients. The patches are more densely packed on the neck with sharper boundaries, becoming slightly more rounded on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a network of thin, continuous pathways. These corridors are characterized by frequent junction nodes and a relatively uniform pixel thickness across the mid-section of the specimen.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a short, dark, and continuous fringe along the upper neck, exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian organism is perched on the dorsal-lateral surface of the upper neck.
